sources.shortCitation: Encyclopédie de la comédie musicale, author entry for René Pujol
sources.fullCitation: Gana, Jacques. “PUJOL (René).” Encyclopédie multimédia de la comédie musicale théâtrale en France.
sources.researchNote: The page gives the civil-status name Amédée Ferdinand Pujol and the dates Bordeaux, 15 May 1878 – Paris, 21 January 1942, together with a list of stage works and press articles. The birth year conflicts across authority sources: the Library of Congress record no2009029783 gives 1888 and GND 1062158474 gives 18 August 1888, while VIAF 44567556 and this encyclopedia give 1878, the latter with the precise date 15 May. All sources agree on the death date, 21 January 1942. The preferred birth year is 1878; the discrepancy remains unresolved.

sources.fullCitation: Gana, Jacques. “POTHIER (Charles-Louis).” Encyclopédie multimédia de la comédie musicale théâtrale en France. Gives the dates Bordeaux, 18 April 1881 – Noyers-sur-Serein (Yonne), 3 November 1962, and describes Pothier as co-librettist with René Pujol under Albert Willemetz at the Bouffes-Parisiens from 1928.

sources.researchNote: The page gives the civil-status name André Jacques Bloch and the dates Paris, 19 August 1891 – Paris, 3 February 1939. The birth year conflicts with the Bibliothèque nationale de France and Wikidata, which both give 1881; day, month and date of death agree across all three sources, so the discrepancy is confined to one digit. The BnF-supported year 1881 is preferred; the conflict remains unresolved.
